info.title: Evidex Agent API
info.description: Create grounded debate cards and export them. Submit exact source text and markdownContent with **bold** highlights to avoid a model call. Omit markdownContent/content to let DeepSeek select the passage. Cards are returned to the caller; this API does not write to a user's browser storage.

post.summary: Generate or validate a highlighted evidence card

200.description: A card whose unmarked excerpt matches its supplied or fetched source, plus token usage (null for a supplied cut).

meta.description: Generation mode, model, source metadata, and actual provider usage.

400.description: Invalid input, malformed highlights, unsupported source, or excerpt not found in the source.

401.description: Missing or invalid Evidex agent bearer token.

422.description: Source fetch failed or document type is unsupported; supply sourceText.

503.description: Server model or agent credentials are not configured.

post.summary: Export a returned card as a Word document

200.description: Word document with the card's highlights

agentToken.description: EVIDEX_AGENT_API_TOKEN, issued by the Evidex owner. Never use the DeepSeek provider key here.

CardInput.description: Provide sourceText or link/sourceUrl. Supply either markdownContent or content for a finished cut; omit both for model generation. A supplied excerpt must be a contiguous exact quote, with whitespace normalization permitted.

link.description: HTTP(S) source URL; optional when sourceText is supplied.

citation.description: Citation copied from the source; otherwise derived from available source metadata.

markdownContent.description: Exact quote with paired **bold** highlight markers.

content.description: Alternative to markdownContent: exact quote with balanced, non-nested <HL>...</HL> highlights.
Canonical source text with <HL>...</HL> highlights; pass through unchanged for export.
